title: Zoning text change for housing at 69-67 108th Street, Queens
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a Zoning Resolution text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 69-67 108th Street in Forest Hills, Queens. It works together with a related zoning map change to allow an 11-story mixed-use building with about 59 apartments, including 15 income-restricted units, and 3,900 square feet of commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on the application on September 9, 2026.
